references.text: Psalm 2:8 mentions that God offers the nations as an inheritance, which reflects the temptation Jesus faced when offered all the kingdoms of the world.
Daniel 4:30 refers to Nebuchadnezzar boasting about his great kingdom, which can be seen as parallel to the temptation regarding worldly dominion.
Matthew 4:8-9 is a parallel event where Satan tempts Jesus by showing him all the kingdoms of the world.
